text:
sarah-m: Hey team — idea: run a "QuickStart Snack" series — 5 tiny tutorials (2–4 min read) + an OSS mini-refapp each week to drive dev onboarding. low-fi, high signal. thoughts? :popcorn:
devrel-jo: love it. short snackable pieces are a hit. suggest pairing each snack with a tiny benchmark card (latency / tokens / cost) so folks can compare quickly.
alex-p: +1. can we ship a simple starter repo per snack (single Dockerfile, 3 endpoints)? I can template it.
sarah-m: yes — template needed. goal: launch 5-week drip, weekly post + tweet + 30-min live office hours after week 3.
maya: for messaging, keep it: "Build an LLM feature in 10 minutes". short explainer, 1 code snippet, 1 screenshot, and a tiny benchmark table.
sam-eng: benchmark idea: measure 3 variants: hosted small (gpt-lite), dedicated medium, quantized private. show p50 latency, cost per 1k tokens. I'll help run numbers.
devrel-jo: ok for channels: marketing blog, community newsletter, Dev Twitter thread, and a Reference Examples repo on GitHub. Also add a community tag for rotating contributors.
sarah-m: task list (quick):
- copy deck for each snack (jo)
- refapp template (alex)
